title: 8 Best SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) Tools for Every Business Size (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: AppOmni and Obsidian lead enterprise SSPM depth; CrowdStrike (Adaptive Shield) the acquired category pioneer fuses SSPM with the Falcon platform; Wing Security wins mid-market value; Spin.AI adds backup-fused resilience. The 2026 driver: OAuth/AI-integration sprawl, where one malicious app grant equals a breach. Your SaaS estate is configured by admins you don’t manage, extended by OAuth apps nobody reviewed, and increasingly wired into AI tools that read everything. SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) continuously audits the settings, identities, and third-party integrations inside Salesforce, M365, Google Workspace, GitHub, and hundreds of other apps the layer CASB’s traffic view never sees. Unmanaged OAuth extensions and third-party SaaS connections can expose core corporate environments, as seen when attackers breached third-party integrations to steal Salesforce CRM data . Consolidation arrived here too: category pioneer Adaptive Shield now lives inside CrowdStrike, and platform vendors (Zscaler via Canonic) absorbed others. This playbook sizes eight options honestly, with the OAuth/GenAI lens that now defines the category. How we evaluate: independent editorial analysis; no paid placement; POC on your own tenants.
